title: Discover Gheralta: A Hiker's Paradise in Tigray
excerpt: Explore dramatic sandstone cliffs and ancient rock‑hewn churches, just a scenic drive from our hotel.
content:
The Gheralta Mountains, located about 65 km from Adigrat, are one of Ethiopia's most breathtaking natural wonders. Towering sandstone cliffs rise dramatically from the earth, concealing a network of rock‑hewn churches dating back to the 4th century.

Guests at Canaan International Hotel can easily arrange a day trip to this UNESCO World Heritage candidate. Our staff can connect you with experienced local guides who lead treks to churches like Abuna Yemata, which requires a thrilling but safe climb up a sheer rock face. The panoramic views from the top are unforgettable.

Best visited from October to March, Gheralta offers hiking for all levels. After a day of adventure, return to the comfort of our hotel and enjoy a traditional Ethiopian meal.
author: Canaan Hotel Team
